giraffeManorTheRetreatDayRooms.inferenceBasis: Explicitly named 'Giraffe Manor' context ('The Retreat', Giraffe Centre access) - highest confidence of the four sections.
giraffeManorTheRetreatDayRooms.note: These are DAY ROOM rates only (not overnight Giraffe Manor accommodation, which this matrix explicitly excludes from its own combination discount). Only one discount tier shown here: 20% Contract with a 30% offer (7-night combo), not the 25/30/35 or 30/35/40 ladder used elsewhere in this document.
giraffeManorTheRetreatDayRooms.validity: 1 Jan 2025 - 31 Dec 2025 (single window, no season split)
giraffeManorTheRetreatDayRooms.inclusions: Arrival/departure transfers (conditions apply), water, soft drinks, snack, use of Retreat facilities (pool, gym, steam room, sauna, hot tub), Giraffe Centre access, subject to availability.
giraffeManorTheRetreatDayRooms.exclusions: Spa treatments, all food/drinks except complimentary snack, excursions, access to Giraffe Manor itself.
giraffeManorTheRetreatDayRooms.bookingRestriction: The Retreat can only be booked in combination with a Safari Collection bush property (Sasaab, Solio Lodge, and/or Sala's Camp) unless the guest is already staying at Giraffe Manor. Max 10 Retreat Day Passes and 8 Early Bird passes per day.

childPolicy: Children aged 3 years - 15 years 364 days. 16+ is adult. Infants (0-2y 364d) stay free. The Retreat at Giraffe Manor has no children's rates, only minimum room rates.

cancellationLadder: More than 120 days before arrival: 20% deposit refunded net of transaction/admin fee (5% of booking value)
45-30 days before arrival: 50% of full value forfeited
